name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-mario
title: Super Mario World - Mario (8-bit)
description:
This is an 8-bit styled SMW Mario, based off of SMB3 Mario's Pallete setup.

It includes the tiles needed for GFX00 and an overworld sprite for Mario.

Contains five files:
-GFX00;
-GFX10;
-GFX32;
-Mario Palette;
-Overworld Palette.

Credit is wanted, since it was kind of annoying to do.
